verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud content platform like Egnyte, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of all data in open formats or an offboarding path. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: ransomware snapshots with in-place restore, MCP query access, and hybrid storage connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
